<!-- DO NOT EDIT | GENERATED CONTENT -->

Copy models from the Hugging Face cache the server reads onto an external drive, to
carry to a machine with no internet. The drive gets a plain copy of each file in a
hub/ folder, which any filesystem holds, and 'llm-helper import' reads it back.

Only complete models are copied, and each file is checked against its recorded
hash as it is copied. FAT32 cannot hold a file over 4 GiB; format the drive as
exFAT.

## Usage

```console
llm-helper export <org/model>... <drive-path> [flags]
```

## Options

### --cache

|      |          |
| ---- | -------- |
| Type | `string` |

hub cache directory to copy from (default: the one the server reads)

### --dry-run

|      |        |
| ---- | ------ |
| Type | `bool` |

show what would be copied and stop
